name: logistics
prompt: Create ONE production-ready pixel-art UI sprite strip for Border Defenders. Use the provided image ONLY as a palette/material/style reference, ignore all its characters and boats. Transparent background, crisp deliberately chunky pixel clusters, worn military olive, bone, rust, muted river teal and pale cyan research accents; no glossy gradients, no text, no labels, no border panels, no drop shadow. A wide horizontal 5-by-1 evenly spaced grid, exactly five icons centered in five equally wide square cells with generous transparent gutters and no clipping. Each icon should read like a hand-drawn 48x48 game icon at small size, consistent overhead inventory view. Output landscape 5:1 strip if possible. Five icons left to right: 1 paper emergency fund banknote bundle with small cyan clip; 2 closed olive supply crate with a contract paper; 3 wrench and recovered metal scrap; 4 schematic branching supply-route map with linked depots; 5 stacked reserve supply crates with a cyan seal.
